Distribution. Currently known only from California USA. According to Govaerts & Frodin (1998), the host plant Q. chrysolepis is found in the USA in California, western Oregon, Arizona, south Nevada, and New Mexico, and in Mexico it is recorded from Baja California and NW Chihuahua. The other host plant, Q. vacciniifolia, is found in California, southwestern Oregon and western Nevada. During 2007 - 2009 the authors sampled many sites across California and Arizona where one or other of the host plants were present, but P. spectabilis was only found in California.
